transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, my name is Nathan. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is my third call. The installer left my internet half working, it keeps cutting out, and nobody has fixed it. I'm absolutely furious.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Calm down, shouting won't make the internet faster. Can I take your PIN?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks, Jasper. So since the installation your internet keeps cutting out, and it hasn't been fixed after two earlier calls. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The installer was from a contractor, so it's not really on us. But let's see. What lights are on the router?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It flashes orange every few minutes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is the cable from the wall pushed fully into the router?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I think so. I'll check. Oh, it was loose. I've pushed it in.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. I've reset the line from my end too. Watch the light for a minute.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's solid white now. Hasn't flashed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you load a page or stream something to check?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So it's working now. All sorted?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Jasper.
